text: おれたちゃ　はしる　より　ここで　だらだら　してる　ほうが　たのしいんだよ！

structure.jp: ここで　だらだら　してる　ほうが
structure.en: lazing around here is the more

patterns.name: 〜より〜ほうが
patterns.span: はしる　より　ここで　だらだら　してる　ほうが
patterns.explanation: より goes after the thing that loses the comparison and ほうが after the thing that wins. はしる より だらだら してる ほうが たのしい = 'lazing around is more fun than riding'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on or is the usual state; here it is shortened to てる as in casual speech. だらだら してる = 'be lazing around'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'the thing is...'. It is the spoken form of のだ. たのしいんだよ = 'it's more fun, you see'.
